content_sections.heading: Calicut University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Calicut University Assistant Professor Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Calicut University Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Calicut University Assistant Professor recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date, 28-09-2026, with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate degree with 55% aggregate in Music, along with NET or Ph.D. in Music.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Assistant Professor post is 50 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Professor position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Assistant Professor (Music) post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Professor role?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 1700 per session of one and half hour for UGC qualified candidates and Rs. 850 per session for others.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates are required to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at Calicut University, Thrissur, Kerala, 680618.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You must bring original certificates along with one set of photocopies for verification, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates if applicable.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a walk-in interview.
